item.title: Pakistan beat USA by 32 runs
item.description: Colombo: Pakistan defeated the United States of America by 32 runs in their Group A T20 World Cup match here on Tuesday. Riding on opener Sahibzada Farhan’s 73 off 41 balls and a late cameo from Shadab Khan (30 off 12), Pakistan posted 190 for 9 after being asked to bat. Pacer Shadley van Schalkwyk (4/25) was once again the pick of bowlers for USA.
